item.text: Cynara humilis (Dwarf Artichoke), also called wild thistle, is a flowering plant in the artichoke and cardoon genus Cynara. It is native to Portugal, Spain, Morocco, Algeria, and Gran Canaria, and is locally used as a coagulant in artisanal sheep- and goat-cheese production. [s1:p2]
